India reported its first case of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV), with an 8-month-old baby testing positive at Baptist Hospital in Bengaluru.

State health dept has acknowledged the private hospital's findings & stated there is no reason to doubt the test results. https://t.co/cSq0bSHez4
